units.source_text: 阿民出殡那天，尽管天下着雨，但是包括村主任在内的所有村民，一个不少全都来参加葬礼。

en.t: On the day of Amin's funeral procession, even though it was raining, every villager, including the village head, came to attend the funeral without a single person missing.

units.source_text: 葬礼上的人，没有人不为阿民扼腕长叹，也对失去了家庭主要劳动力的阿住和广次深表同情。

en.t: Everyone at the funeral sighed deeply for Amin, and they also felt profound sympathy for Aju and Hirotsugu, who had lost the main worker in their household.

units.source_text: 村民代表还说起，本来最近郡公所计划赞扬勤奋的阿民。

en.t: The villagers' representative also mentioned that the county office had recently been planning to commend the hardworking Amin.

units.source_text: 阿住听了这些话，除了致谢也没有其他话可说。

en.t: After hearing these words, Aju had nothing else to say except to offer thanks.

units.source_text: 去年开始，我们就对赞扬阿民的事情，向郡公所提出了申请，村主任和我花了不少火车票钱，

en.t: Since last year, we had applied to the county office about giving Amin a commendation, and the village head and I spent quite a lot of money on train fares,

units.source_text: 前前后后见了郡公所长五次，真是煞费苦心啊 ！

en.t: we went back and forth to meet the county office chief five times, and truly went to great pains over it!

units.source_text: 事已至此，我们也只能死心了，你们也只能死心了。”

en.t: Now that things have come to this, we can only give up, and you can only give up too.

units.source_text: ——村民代表头有些秃，是个老好人，最后他补上这么一句玩笑话，

en.t: The villagers' representative, a slightly balding good-natured man, added this joking remark at the end,

units.source_text: 让年轻的小学老师非常不满的瞪着他看。

en.t: which made the young elementary school teacher glare at him with great displeasure.
